meta.label: Insulated and down jackets
meta.attribution: These are brands that sell insulated or down jackets, compared on three things a buyer can check. Down sourcing comes from the Wear It Kind directory published by the animal welfare charity FOUR PAWS, which rates each brand in one of four traffic-light levels, red to green, on how far it has acted to rule out live plucking of geese and ducks. The rating describes the brand's policy and disclosure and does not describe any one jacket. Each brand's review date is in its note, and several reviews date from 2024, so a brand may have changed since. A high score can mean a brand uses no virgin down at all, as with a synthetic-insulation label, and says nothing about warmth or price. Repairability comes from each brand's own repair or warranty page, read in September 2026, and rewards repairs offered for wear and accidental damage, published prices and stated waiting times. Labor comes only from the Fair Wear Foundation's public brand pages, which give each member's total benchmarking score from its Brand Performance Check; it measures how well a member's due diligence system works, is 0 to 100 as Fair Wear reports it, and exists only for members, so most brands here have no labor score. No price score is given, because jacket prices vary by model and change with the season. The North Face and Columbia publish repair terms that could not be read automatically, and Jack Wolfskin's repair page could not be read cleanly. H&M, Zara, Nike, Decathlon and Save The Duck carry a down score only because no repair terms were read for them. Rab and Mountain Equipment are not in the FOUR PAWS directory and are left out. The cheapest jacket is the one you already own, and mending or reproofing it is covered in the repair and tailoring decision. Reviewed 2026-09. Suggest changes via Contribute.

products.name: Patagonia
products.description: Down and synthetic insulated jackets, with a repair service and a used-gear resale programme.

ethics.note: FOUR PAWS' Wear It Kind directory rates Patagonia in its second-highest of four levels for live plucking in down (yellow, good progress), at a review dated 04.2024. The directory describes that level as a brand that discloses a strong commitment beyond certification to rule out live plucking, or a timebound target to cut down use by at least half.

repairability.note: Patagonia's Worn Wear repairs page says its repair technicians can try to fix damaged gear that is mailed in or brought to a store, and that gear beyond repair is recycled. It also points to more than 100 care and repair guides made with iFixit. The page gives no price or waiting time.

products.name: The North Face
products.description: Insulated and down jackets sold under The North Face name.

ethics.note: FOUR PAWS' Wear It Kind directory rates The North Face in its second-lowest of four levels for live plucking in down (orange, needs improvement), at a review dated 05.2024. The directory describes that level as a brand that uses 100 per cent certified virgin down, alone or mixed with recycled down, or does not appear to use down but has not made that clear.

products.name: Arc'teryx
products.description: Down and synthetic jackets with a repair programme and service centres.

ethics.note: FOUR PAWS' Wear It Kind directory rates Arc'teryx in its second-lowest of four levels for live plucking in down (orange, needs improvement), at a review dated 03.2024. The directory describes that level as a brand that uses 100 per cent certified virgin down, alone or mixed with recycled down, or does not appear to use down but has not made that clear.

repairability.note: Arc'teryx's product service page states its ReBIRD Promise to repair gear for as long as it remains repairable, regardless of the product's age or how the damage occurred, subject to limited exceptions. Minor repairs are free in store or at home, and complex repairs get a free evaluation and a quote the owner approves before any fee-based work.

products.name: Canada Goose
products.description: Insulated parkas, warranted against manufacturing defects for the lifetime of the product.

ethics.note: FOUR PAWS' Wear It Kind directory rates Canada Goose in its second-lowest of four levels for live plucking in down (orange, needs improvement), at a review dated 06.2024. The directory describes that level as a brand that uses 100 per cent certified virgin down, alone or mixed with recycled down, or does not appear to use down but has not made that clear.

repairability.note: Canada Goose's warranty page covers insulated outerwear against manufacturing defects for the lifetime of the product and says covered repairs are free. Damage from normal wear, accidents or improper care is excluded, but if it is repairable the company may offer a repair for a reasonable charge, discussed before any work. The tags must be intact.

repairability.note: Uniqlo's UK RE.UNIQLO Studio price list has a repair menu with a down repair heading among its categories, priced from 3 pounds, and states that all prices apply to Uniqlo items only.

products.name: Fjällräven
products.description: Down and synthetic jackets, with repairs handled at flagship stores or by post.

ethics.note: FOUR PAWS' Wear It Kind directory rates Fjällräven in its highest of four levels for live plucking in down (green, highest positive action), at a review dated 06.2024. The directory describes that level as a brand that discloses a detailed strategy to rule out live plucking, does not use virgin down, or has a timebound target to end down use.

repairability.note: Fjällräven's North America support page says only flagship stores can process repairs at present, with no appointment needed if the item is clean, and that customers elsewhere can ask its warranty team to approve a mail-in repair at a repair hub. The page gives no repair prices or waiting time.

products.name: Mammut
products.description: Down jackets and other mountain clothing, with a published repair price list.

ethics.note: FOUR PAWS' Wear It Kind directory rates Mammut in its second-lowest of four levels for live plucking in down (orange, needs improvement), at a review dated 07.2024. The directory describes that level as a brand that uses 100 per cent certified virgin down, alone or mixed with recycled down, or does not appear to use down but has not made that clear.

repairability.note: Mammut's help centre publishes a repair price list in euros that includes covering a down baffle with fabric at 45 euros, patching a hole or tear at 25 euros, redistributing down filling from 30 euros and a seam stitch repair at 10 euros.

labor.note: Fair Wear's Mammut brand page lists a total benchmarking score of 64 from its Brand Performance Check, made up of 64 per cent for risk identification and sourcing, 58 per cent for prevention and remediation and 89 per cent for communication. Mammut has been a member since 2008.
